chargeData.chargeDescription: Arrest on a city ordinance charge of disorderly conduct

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel: Expungement of a city ordinance arrest record under K.S.A. 12-4516a(c) on the ground that expungement would be in the best interests of justice and the charges have been dismissed
additionalFacts: Petitioner asks the Court to set a hearing date and to give notice to the prosecuting attorney and the arresting law enforcement agency, as the statute directs.
Petitioner asks the Court to find that expungement would be in the best interests of justice and that the charges arising from the arrest identified above have been dismissed.
Petitioner states the circumstances relied on in the accompanying statement; that statement is completed by Petitioner and is not supplied by any other person.

attachments: Certified municipal court record showing dismissal
